explication: MarkItDown is a Python utility that accepts local files, streams, or URIs and returns Markdown for LLM-oriented text analysis. The principal workflow is CLI/API or MCP request → resource acquisition and metadata → converter selection → format-specific extraction and normalization → Markdown result. Built-in converters cover documents, media, web/text formats, archives, and online sources. Optional plugins, OCR, and Azure services extend conversion. The map uses sampled orchestration and converter code plus README-documented capabilities; several converter implementations were not sampled.
